title: A good kind of busy
description: Equal-size circles compare two measurements with clear spacing and stable identity colors.

props.name: data
props.description: Unique nonempty IDs, labels, signed numeric x/y coordinates and optional tones a–d. Incomplete or non-finite pairs are omitted and counted. Zero remains a complete observation; colors identify observations rather than quantity.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Horizontal measurement label; defaults to X value.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Vertical measurement label; defaults to Y value.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense categorical plots scroll locally when the supplied size cannot hold their data.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
